^Zale: You two! We need more hands!
^Zale: The cliffside fell through suddenly and we don't have enough people to lift it off.
choicesorryimnotsure: ^Zale: You're a Krakenfolk, you can swim, come on.

choicesureicantry: ^Zale: We've got a pile of heavy rocks to lift. Race you to the water!

Atthewater: ^Narrator: The commotion seems to be in the east, around the corner.
A6_S3_D2: ^Narrator: A cliff has indeed collapsed, fallen onto the beach and a bit of the ocean.
^Narrator: A large chunk of earth stays intact with itself — like a giant rock. Which is what a group of Ichthyos and Krakenfolk are attempting to pry off the water.
^Narrator: Your stomach lurches as you realize there are people trapped underneath. Perhaps there was an underwater cove or cave?
^Narrator: You dive into the water, joining the group who are coordinating to push and pull in sync.
^Narrator: You quickly tell the person next to you that you’ll be back with something to help.
^Amelia: Noelle…? I know you're thinking of something strange again. Spit it out.
^Noelle: Something needs to be wedged in between the rock and the beach. Otherwise, we’ve got no chance of moving it with our own strength.
^Amelia: But something big enough to do that surely can’t be lugged here, either.
^Noelle: I think I know what we can use.
A6_S3_D3: ^Noelle: (Let’s drop our things off at the Ichthyos village, first.)

^Noelle: …If it cracks, at least its skeleton can also be used to pry that rock. And I can just sail it over.
^Narrator: You and Amelia quickly trek down the island, fetching your boat for its first and potentially last test-drive.
^Hint: Now, back to Zale and others who are trying to pry off the rock.
^Hint: You can wait for Noelle and Amelia to arrive from their point of view!

^Amelia: Okay, this thing is definitely gonna split in half!

^Zale: You two, thanks so much for the help!
